items.definition:
to break into pieces violently
He accidentally smashed the glass.

To lose blood.
His nose started to bleed after the fall.

To reproduce or cause to reproduce.
Many animals breed in the spring.

To drop or let fall.
He dumped the rubbish in the bin.

To use up or tire out completely.
The long hike completely exhausted us.

to arrange or put in order
We need to organise the event.

tell someone something positively to remove any doubt
I can assure you that the information is accurate.

focus all one's attention on a particular object or activity
It's hard to concentrate with all this noise.

cause the water or other liquid in (something) to run out
Please drain the pasta before adding the sauce.

recognise
I didn't recognise him at first.

scan
Please scan this document and email it to me.

to seek advice or information from
You should consult a doctor if the pain continues.

to discover or identify the presence of
The security system can detect any unauthorized entry.

to give money or goods for a good cause
Many people choose to donate blood regularly.

to demand forcefully
He insisted on paying for the meal.

to make the sound of a word or letter
How do you pronounce this word?

to change or cause to change in character or composition
We had to alter our plans.

to ask (someone) earnestly or humbly for something
He begged for forgiveness.

to interrupt; to bother
Please do not disturb the sleeping baby.

to run away from a place or situation of danger
The refugees were forced to flee their homes.

to act in such a way as to have an effect on another
It's important for children to interact with others.

to take back or remove
He decided to withdraw his application.

to deal effectively with something difficult
It's hard to cope with so much stress.

to be different
Our opinions often differ on political matters.

to have or own something
He possesses great skill in playing the piano.

to arrange to receive something regularly, typically a publication or service
You can subscribe to our newsletter online.

to place, fit, or push (something) into something else
Please insert the key into the lock.

to express disapproval of someone or something
It's easy to criticize others, but harder to offer solutions.

to make someone suffer for a crime or wrongdoing
The teacher had to punish the student for cheating.

move secretly
He tried to sneak out of the house unnoticed.

transfer data to a larger computer system
Please upload the document to the shared drive.

to respect and approve of someone or something
I admire her dedication to her work.

to put together
We need to assemble the new furniture.

to refuse to allow (something)
My parents forbid me from staying out late.

urinate
The dog needs to pee.

run at full speed
He had to sprint to catch the bus.

destroy or severely damage
The storm could wreck the ship.

to mix together
Blend the ingredients until smooth.

to eat, drink, or use up
We consume a lot of electricity.

to walk a long distance, especially in the country or mountains
We decided to hike to the top of the mountain.

to exhale audibly
She sighed with relief.

to cause to feel extreme fear
The loud noise terrified the cat.

to jump a long way or to a great height
The deer leaped over the fence.

firmly press (something soft or pliable), typically to extract liquid or alter its shape
Squeeze the lemon to get the juice.

exchange (one thing) for another
Let's swap seats.

to produce flowers
The roses in the garden will bloom beautifully in spring.

to avoid (something) by moving quickly
He had to dodge a falling branch as he walked through the forest.

to stop; to bring to a stop
The police ordered the car to halt at the checkpoint.

to cause someone to feel upset or angry
I didn't mean to offend you.

to guide the movement of a vehicle
He steered the car around the corner.

to take in a liquid, gas, or other substance
The sponge can absorb a lot of water.

to officially register as a member of an institution or a student on a course
She decided to enroll in a language course.

to surprise greatly
Her talent continues to amaze me.

examine in detail
We need to analyze the data carefully.

to come or bring together for a common purpose or action
The team needs to unite to win the championship.

carve
He used a knife to carve the wood.

prevent someone from concentrating
Please don't distract me while I'm working.

gradually grow faint or disappear
The colors of the old photograph began to fade.

to move something downwards
Please lower your voice.

make (something) less confusing and more comprehensible
Could you please clarify your last point?

to stop someone from speaking or doing something
Please don't interrupt me when I'm talking.

to eject saliva from the mouth
It's rude to spit on the street.

move slowly and carefully in order to avoid being heard or noticed
The cat tried to creep silently towards the bird.

to teach or direct
Please instruct me on how to use this machine.
